t: This is the Lister Hospital in Chelsea, on Chelsea Bridge Road. It is a private hospital, owned by the Hospital Corporation of America, and is not part of the NHS. The building was designed by the architects Alfred Waterhouse and his son Paul Waterhouse. Alfred is best known for Manchester Town Hall and the Natural History Museum. Several well-known people died here, including Sir Denis Thatcher, husband of Margaret Thatcher, the first female prime minister. The Cabinet minister Paul Channon and the businessman Tony Keswick also died here.
